description: PRISM dual-perspective review rubric. All reviewers evaluate against this identical schema.

correctness.description: Code logic is correct, no bugs or regressions introduced
checks: No off-by-one errors in loops or array indexing
Conditional logic matches the intended behavior
Return values match declared types
Async/await used correctly (no unhandled promises)

completeness.description: All required functionality is implemented, nothing missing
checks: All actions specified in the task are implemented
Edge cases handled (empty input, null, undefined, NaN)
Error paths return structured error objects, not thrown exceptions
Required exports are present in index.ts

consistency.description: Code follows project conventions and patterns
checks: Follows PRISM engine conventions (static methods, AtomicValue returns)
Uses Zod schemas for input validation
Naming matches existing patterns (PascalCaseEngine.ts)
Import style matches project (import from, not require)

safety.description: No security vulnerabilities or unsafe operations
checks: No hardcoded secrets or API keys
No console.log in production code
No 'any' type annotations
No shell command injection (use execFileNoThrow, not exec)
No unsafe filesystem operations outside project directory

performance.description: Code is reasonably efficient, no unnecessary computation
checks: No O(n²) where O(n) is possible
No unnecessary re-computation in loops
Large data structures use lazy loading
Async operations parallelized where independent

physics_accuracy.description: Physics formulas and constants are correct per canonical sources
checks: Kienzle kc1.1 values imported from src/physics/constants.ts (never inline)
Taylor tool life exponents (C, n) from tool registry or constants
Uncertainty propagation uses RSS for independent variables
AtomicValue includes unit, uncertainty, source, confidence
Dimensional consistency verified (Force=Pa*m², Power=Force*velocity)
Safety factors applied AFTER uncertainty, never before
Numerical constants cite their source (ISO, Sandvik, Kennametal, textbook)

shop_acceptance.description: Output would be accepted by a CNC machinist on the shop floor
checks: Depth of cut sustainable for material + machine combination
Spindle load prediction < 90% of machine rated capacity
Feed rate within machine servo limits
Tool coating temperature limit respected (AlTiN ~900C, uncoated ~600C)
Recommended RPM is within machine spindle range (min/max)
Coolant strategy matches operation type (flood, mist, through-spindle)
Surface finish prediction is realistic for the cutting parameters

scoring.per_dimension: Each dimension scored independently as PASS/WARN/FAIL
scoring.aggregation: Overall PASS if all dimensions are PASS or WARN. Overall FAIL if any dimension is FAIL.
scoring.threshold: WARN means 'acceptable with noted concerns'. FAIL means 'must fix before proceeding'.

disputed_findings_policy.agreed_critical_high: MUST FIX — both reviewers found this issue
disputed_findings_policy.disputed_critical_high: MUST FIX — even if only 1 reviewer found it, CRITICAL/HIGH issues cannot be ignored
disputed_findings_policy.disputed_medium: DEFER with written justification — logged in PRISM_REVIEW_LOG.jsonl for audit trail
disputed_findings_policy.agreed_low: Optional fix — nice to have but not blocking
